metadata.description: Cascade model fitting for retinal recordings, in the CascadeGraph parameterization

plugins.name: ln-fitting-procedure
plugins.description: Fitting and debugging parametric cascade models of neural stimulus-response data -- LN, GLM with feedback, two-arm -- in the CascadeGraph parameterization. Staged Nelder-Mead pipeline with random restarts, free-running feedback, per-epoch variance explained, and automatic diagnostics that catch the failure modes a good R^2 hides.
